plans.mechanism: Split one premium-product B1 sale, reserve half for exactly four turns, then sell the available reserved remainder without rolling the deadline.
plans.observable_trigger: Before step 704, B1 sells at least four MILK/WOOL/STRAWBERRY/EGG, no fixed-price purchase is in the same market list, projected capacity is below 85, and the all-product public ledger has non-UNKNOWN evidence supporting a non-worse four-turn price.
start_preconditions: reserved sale is not needed to fund a same-turn fixed-price purchase

funding_and_stock_reserves.stock: half of the eligible sale, capped by reconciled available stock
funding_and_stock_reserves.capacity: reserved quantity remains charged against capacity

mandatory_jobs: sell available remainder at or before due_step
plans.sale_calendar: partial sale at trigger; remaining available stock at fixed due_step, earlier only if the public comparison improves
completion_postconditions: due sale emitted or zero-stock expiry recorded
plans.rejoin_contract_or_continuation_owner: B1 owns farm work; M1 owns only active reservations until reconciliation and completion.
plans.failure_and_expiry_action: If validation fails, keep B1. At due_step sell only reconciled available quantity and expire; never convert an unsupported cancellation to WAIT.

plans.mechanism: Fund four day-2/3 strawberry plants by replacing one initial COW with four seeds; use B1's native day-2 cow repurchase and substitute native wheat replants rather than buying land.
plans.observable_trigger: At step 1 B1 orders at least two cows and a market slot remains for four strawberry seeds; during days 2-3 an on-site B1 actor is about to PLANT WHEAT on an empty tile.
read_set: own actor positions and final commands
start_preconditions: one initial cow reduction exactly funds four seeds at 400
four suitable B1 wheat-replant opportunities appear by step 95

funding_and_stock_reserves.cash: 400 diverted from one initial cow; cow expected from B1 native day-2 repurchase
funding_and_stock_reserves.duplicate_investment: remove four units from B1 day-5 strawberry seed purchase

plans.actor_and_tile_assignments: Only actors already on an owned target may be reassigned; moving B1 actors are never stolen. The plan owns each target against B1 DIG/PLANT/HARVEST/FEED/CARE/PLACE conflicts.
mandatory_jobs: let B1 return inventory to shed
plans.production_calendar: plant days 2-3, then official biological clock with daily watering and harvest when yield_units > 0
plans.delivery_calendar: B1 logistics retains ownership; no remote plan worker is diverted for delivery
plans.sale_calendar: sell the projected shed quantity when price > 1 or in endgame
completion_postconditions: four later seed units suppressed when B1 orders them
plans.rejoin_contract_or_continuation_owner: Plan permanently owns target tiles; B1 owns unrelated tiles, livestock, movement, delivery, and market orders except the plan's sale gap.
plans.failure_and_expiry_action: If step-1 funding fails, expire without change. If fewer than four plants exist by step 96, mark INVALID rather than claim the strategy was tested.

plans.mechanism: After the last currently available wool/fertilizer has been collected, stop feeding an adjacent pair of sheep, wait for their official exit, DIG both empty pastures, choose WHEAT/CARROT/TOMATO for delivery-time value, cultivate and sell.
plans.observable_trigger: Day 18-21 after hour 18, public wool price <= 30, and an adjacent sheep pair has yield_units=0 and fertilizer_available=false.
write_set: FEED/CARE/PLACE suppression on two owned tiles
start_preconditions: sufficient remaining official lifetime for selected crop

funding_and_stock_reserves.cash: validator charges crop seeds jointly with all B1 orders
funding_and_stock_reserves.stock: harvest remains capacity-charged until B1/plan delivery
funding_and_stock_reserves.abandoned_profit: future sheep wool/fertilizer is intentionally surrendered and measured by fullgame delta

plans.actor_and_tile_assignments: The plan owns both tiles from trigger through terminal. On-site actors take deadline jobs first; only PASS actors may travel, so moving B1 workers do not lose unrelated jobs.
mandatory_jobs: wait for both animals to exit
plans.production_calendar: selected once at trigger from projected sale value using crop delay/yield, public demand and opponent crop tiles
plans.delivery_calendar: crop-carrying actors receive shed delivery priority; otherwise B1 jobs remain
plans.sale_calendar: sell delivered selected crop above price floor or at endgame
completion_postconditions: at least two replacement plants executed
plans.rejoin_contract_or_continuation_owner: No rejoin for the two tiles; plan owns them after livestock exit. B1 continues everywhere else.
plans.failure_and_expiry_action: If no qualifying pair appears, remain identical to B1. If insufficient lifetime remains, suppress new planting and retain explicit incomplete status.

plans.mechanism: Composition of M1 and P_EARLY4 through one B1 call, validating the market candidate before using it as the production parent.
plans.observable_trigger: Union of M1 and P_EARLY4 observable triggers.
plans.funding_and_stock_reserves: Joint action validator simulates all slots, purchases, sales, cash and capacity.
plans.rejoin_contract_or_continuation_owner: Component-specific ownership; no repeated parent calls.
plans.failure_and_expiry_action: Keep the last valid component or B1. This composition was built and loader-tested but was not admitted to the 192-game panel after both individual mechanisms failed development gates.
